items.title: Jane Ira Bloom interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 3, 1998
items.q: Continuing to play with my trio with Bobby Previte on drums... I’ve been doing some quartet recording, that also involved... Bobby Previte on drums.

ctx.x: What’s the immediate future for you as far as upcoming gigs, concerts?

Museum of Modern Art in New York this coming month. Continuing to play with my trio with Bobby Previte on drums, Cameron Brown will be playing bass and sometimes Mark Dresser plays bass. Finishing a recording for Arabesque that’s coming up this spring, I’ve been doing some quartet recording, that also involved Fred Hersch on piano, Mark Dresser on bass and Bobby Previte on drums. This was the group that played Sweet Basil’s last year, and just raised the bandstand it was so wonderful. Anyway, what else am I up…
Are you able to take your own group when you go?
